name: @ondewo/s2t-client-nodejs
description: ONDEWO Speech to Text (S2T) Client library for Nodejs
author: ONDEWO GmbH <office@ondewo.com>

scripts.build:auth: tsc auth/offlineTokenProvider.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --declaration --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types
scripts.build:tests: rm -rf .test-build && tsc auth/*.ts examples/*.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --sourceMap --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --outDir .test-build && ln -sfn ../api .test-build/api && test -f .test-build/auth/offlineTokenProvider.js && test -f .test-build/examples/s2tClient.js && test -f .test-build/examples/getServiceInfo.js
scripts.typecheck:examples: tsc examples/*.ts --ignoreConfig --noEmit --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types
scripts.test:drift: node -e "const p=require('./package.json'),c=require('./.ci-package.json'),d=[];for(const s of ['scripts','devDependencies','dependencies'])for(const k of Object.keys(c[s]||{}))if((p[s]||{})[k]!==c[s][k])d.push(s+'.'+k+' -> package.json: '+JSON.stringify((p[s]||{})[k])+' | .ci-package.json: '+JSON.stringify(c[s][k]));if(d.length){console.error('DRIFT: package.json and .ci-package.json disagree on '+d.length+' key(s):');for(const m of d)console.error('  '+m);process.exit(1)}console.log('OK: package.json matches .ci-package.json on every script and dependency it declares')"
